mapper.sql: id, season_key, goods_id, `day`, tier, score, reasons, status, config_version_hash, config_snapshot, add_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_season_candidate (season_key, goods_id, `day`, tier, score, reasons, status, config_version_hash, config_snapshot, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{seasonKey}, #{goodsId}, #{day}, #{tier}, coalesce(#{score}, 0.00), #{reasons}, coalesce(#{status}, 'proposed'), #{configVersionHash}, #{configSnapshot}, now(), now(), 0) on duplicate key update tier = if(status = 'dismissed', tier, values(tier)), score = if(status = 'dismissed', score, values(score)), reasons = if(status = 'dismissed', reasons, values(reasons)), status = if(status = 'dismissed', status, values(status)), config_version_hash = if(status = 'dismissed', config_version_hash, values(config_version_hash)), config_snapshot = if(status = 'dismissed', config_snapshot, values(config_snapshot)), update_time = if(status = 'dismissed', update_time, now())
mapper.select: select max(`day`) from litemall_season_candidate where season_key = #{seasonKey} and deleted = 0

select goods_id from litemall_season_candidate where season_key = #{seasonKey} and status = 'auto' and deleted = 0 and `day` = (select max(`day`) from litemall_season_candidate where season_key = #{seasonKey} and status = 'auto' and deleted = 0) order by score desc, goods_id asc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from litemall_season_candidate where season_key = #{seasonKey} and goods_id = #{goodsId} and status = 'dismissed' and deleted = 0
